serve_fastgpt_model: serve a FastGPTLanguageModel on a given IP and port using gpt-fast compiled checkpoint
serve_autotransformers_model: serve an AutoTransformersLanguageModel on a given IP and port using HuggingFace transformers
launch_slurm_servers: launch multiple LLM server instances on a SLURM cluster using submitit executor
keep_alive_check: keep remote language model servers alive by polling and sending keep_alive requests
batch_generate_with_grammar: generate text from prompts using AutoTransformersLanguageModel with optional grammar constraints
